title: How To Pray
text: this is how I pray I got us from the Bible first you start private Thanksgiving you never go in to the courtroom of God demanding things first you thank him for what he's already done are you with me so I want you to stop thanking God for the things that he's already done then the next step is you begin to declare his word that's what he wants to hear then you express the promises that he made that's your demands and then you wait on him he always wants meditation quietness and then you speak in tongues let the Holy Ghost help you pray that's what I do it works every time Thanksgiving declaration expression of promises quietness and talks petition
